use_when.text: Use Grid in two-column item lists on mobile.
Use List in search results and dense lists where people scan names.
Use Grid Large for featured items and the item detail preview.
Use Hover when the pointer is over the card.
Write Meta as place and time, such as Central Station · 2h ago.

dont_use_when.text: Do not show more than one status on a card.
Do not put actions such as Claim inside the card. Put them on the item page.
Do not mix Grid and List cards in the same list.
Do not stretch a photo out of shape. Crop it to fill the Photo area.
Do not recolour the card outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Use a clear photo of the item on a plain background, so people recognise it quickly.
Keep titles short and specific, such as Black leather wallet rather than Wallet.

variant_intent.intent: Use Grid in two-column item lists on mobile.
Use List in search results and dense lists where people scan names.
Use Grid Large for featured items and the item detail preview.
Use Hover when the pointer is over the card.

placement.text: Two-column item lists on mobile, in Grid.
Search results and dense lists, in List.
Featured items and the item detail preview, in Grid Large.

pairs_with.how: Nested Status Badge above the Title, Found by default; off with "Show status"
box Icon at Size xl as the photo placeholder when no Photo is given

a11y.text: The whole card is one <a> element, with href defaulting to "#".
Its accessible name is the Title, through aria-labelledby; aria-describedby points at the Status Badge (when shown) and the Meta.
A Photo renders an whose alt is PhotoAlt (empty by default); without a Photo the placeholder Icon is aria-hidden.
Make the whole card one link to the item page, with the title as its accessible name.
Give photos alt text that describes the item. Mark the placeholder icon aria-hidden="true".
Read the status as text, not colour alone. The badge label does this.
Keep a visible focus indicator on the card when it is reached by keyboard.
Title and meta text are above 4.5:1 on the card background.
